protocol.title: Cross-sectional options implied-vol TERM-SLOPE basis (BTC-vs-ETH relative near-to-far ATM IV term slope) -> subsequent relative *vol-of-vol* spread (BTC-minus-ETH forward std(squared log returns)): wrapper-free Spearman rank information coefficient (predictiveness) falsification on the real on-disk three-way captures
protocol.extends: EVAL-74 (same causal term_slope reconstruction ``term_slope = (IV(near) - IV(far)) / (T_near - T_far)`` from the real Deribit option trade tape, reused verbatim) and EVAL-77 (same cross-sectional BTC-vs-ETH alignment and ``_relative_signal_series``, reused verbatim) and EVAL-84/90 (same forward vol-of-vol definition, reused verbatim) but a DISTINCT cell: the *cross-sectional term-slope basis* (not the single-underlying term_slope of EVAL-84/96/99/104, not the cross-sectional atm_iv basis of EVAL-90, not the cross-sectional term-ratio basis of EVAL-107, not the cross-sectional tail-asymmetry basis of EVAL-106) with the forward relative *vol-of-vol* spread (not the relative tail-asymmetry spread of EVAL-106, not the relative RV spread of EVAL-93); no new acquisition
protocol.supersedes: nothing — this is the cross-sectional term-slope partner to EVAL-90 (atm_iv basis -> relative vol-of-vol), EVAL-106 (term-slope basis -> relative tail-asymmetry), EVAL-107 (term-ratio basis -> relative vol-of-vol); all use the same sealed signal/target reconstructions. It makes a predictiveness claim only, no traded-form / monetization claim

cross_section.target: y_k = Vov_BTC(k) - Vov_ETH(k) with Vov_i(k) = sqrt(mean((v_j - mean(v))^2)), v_j = r_j^2, r_j = log(close_j/close_{j-1}) over next H perp bars (forward relative vol-of-vol spread)

protocol.signal: causal per-bar implied-vol term slope from the real Deribit option trade tape (EVAL-74 ``_term_bars``): near-ATM trades grouped by expiry; term_slope = (IV(near) - IV(far)) / (T_near - T_far); the term_slope field is overlaid by bar_open_ms onto EVAL-77's common aligned cross-section; the relative series (ETH - BTC) is forward-filled then expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e77._relative_signal_series / e61.expanding_zscore).
protocol.target_detail: forward relative vol-of-vol = per underlying vol-of-vol sqrt(mean((v_j - mean(v))^2)) with v_j = r_j^2 (squared log returns) over the next H perp bars (strictly after the decision at bar k, EVAL-84/90 verbatim), then BTC minus ETH on the common aligned bar grid
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(rel_z_k, y_k) over the common aligned bar-ends (H1: IC > 0, ETH term-slope-richness predicts BTC subsequently carries the richer forward vol-of-vol — relative turbulence)

stats.permutation: directional (H1: IC>0), shuffle the relative vol-of-vol spread

protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH floors satisfied, at least one config (term_slope basis x bar grid x horizon) has Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, at least min_usable_pairs_per_config usable pairs, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
